metadata.description: Marketplace hosting the sag-agents plugin — SAG as a shared, writable knowledge base for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: sag-agents
plugins.description: SAG knowledge base integration — 8 read tools via SAG's built-in MCP, plus 6 write tools (sagw) + the sagctl CLI for publish/unpublish/reprocess/sync/maintain. Does not modify SAG source code — all operations go through the public REST API.
